items.quote: Zahlbar 14 Tage nach Rechnungsdatum per Überweisung.
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 21.11.2026 (a Saturday). Per §187 Abs. 1 BGB, since the period is measured 'nach' (after) a specifying day, that day itself is not counted; the period begins on 22.11.2026. Per §188 Abs. 1 BGB a period of 14 days ends on the 14th day after the triggering day, i.e. 21.11.2026 + 14 days = 05.12.2026. 05.12.2026 falls on a Sunday. Per §193 BGB, if the last day of a period for performing an act (here: making a payment) falls on a Sunday, Saturday or statutory holiday, the period ends on the next working day, i.e. Monday 07.12.2026 (no public holiday in NW on that date).
